scenario: A homeowner prepares a formal property tax appeal. They use legaldoc-ai to extract and summarize key terms from their county tax assessment notice (assessed value, comparable sales figures, appeal deadline). They then use financial-calculator to compute the adjusted fair market value and estimated tax savings. Finally, they use reporting to generate a structured appeal package to submit to the county assessor.
info_flow: legaldoc-ai reads the assessment notice and produces a structured summary with assessed value and comparable sales data → financial-calculator uses those figures to compute adjusted fair market value and annual tax savings → reporting assembles the output into a formatted property tax appeal package.
